sealedCommitments.name: community_seed_v1
sealedCommitments.note: Pre-committed SHA-256 hashes for 24 held-out cases (12 risky, 12 safe). Plaintext change strings are withheld from the repository so neither rule authors nor models can tune against them prior to evaluation reveal. Pass --reveal <path-to-community_seed_v1.revealed.json> to benchmark/run.ts to verify hashes and score.
